list.title: Orders
list.description: Purchase orders created from the quotations you accepted.
list.emptyDescription: Accept a quotation on one of your RFQs and the purchase order appears here.

detail.tradeAssuranceHint: Funds are held by a licensed payment partner and released to the supplier only after you confirm receipt.
detail.timelineEmpty: Nothing has happened on this order yet.
detail.noInspections: No inspection booked for this order.
detail.financingHint: Need more time to pay? Apply for import financing against this order.
detail.logisticsHint: Compare freight quotes from vetted Vietnamese forwarders.
detail.disputeOpen: A dispute is open on this order

next.PURCHASE_ORDER: The supplier is reviewing your purchase order. Once they confirm it, you can pay the deposit.
next.PAYMENT: Pay the deposit to release the order into production. Your payment is held under Trade Assurance.
next.PRODUCTION: Your goods are being produced. Book a during-production or pre-shipment inspection if you want eyes on the line.
next.QUALITY_INSPECTION: Quality inspection is under way. Review the report before the balance is paid.
next.SHIPPING: The goods are on their way. Track the shipment and prepare the customs documents.
next.DELIVERY: Delivered — check the goods, then confirm receipt to release the payment to the supplier.
next.COMPLETED: This order is complete. Leave a review to help other buyers.
next.DISPUTED: A dispute is open. Our team is reviewing the case with both parties.

actions.completeDescriptionEscrow: The order is marked complete and {count} held payment(s) are released to the supplier. Only do this once you have checked the goods.
actions.completeNoteHint: Added to the order timeline and visible to the supplier.
actions.deliveredDescription: This moves the order to Delivered. You can still open a dispute during the inspection window.
actions.deliveredNotePlaceholder: e.g. 40 cartons received at the Hamburg warehouse on 12 March.
actions.inspectionDescription: A licensed inspection partner visits the factory and shares the report with you.
actions.inspectionProviderHint: Leave on "any" and our team will assign the closest partner.
actions.inspectionNotesPlaceholder: Stitching quality, colour against approved sample, carton marking, AQL 2.5…
actions.uploadTitle: Share a document with the supplier
actions.uploadDescription: Files you upload here are visible to the supplier on this order.
actions.uploadHint: PDF, images or Office documents — up to 10 MB each.
actions.disputeDescription: The order is frozen, the supplier must respond within 5 days and our mediation team is notified.
actions.disputeDetailsHint: Be factual: quantities, dates, what you expected and what you received.
actions.disputeAmountHint: Optional — the value you are asking to be refunded.
actions.cancelDescription: The supplier is notified immediately. Payments already made are handled by our finance team.

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.description: Track every shipment on your orders, from the factory gate to your door.
shipments.emptyDescription: Once freight is booked on an order, the shipment and its milestones appear here.
shipments.confirmReceiptHint: The goods were delivered. Inspect them and confirm receipt on the order to release the payment to the supplier.
